dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave spline curvature (falcate) transitioning from the apex down to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded-acute; the highest point displays a narrow radius of curvature with a distinct apical turn.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a steep linear incline of approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's maximum base width to its vertical height is approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and deep V-shaped notching present along the posterior dorsal ridge following the fin; the lateral surface of the fin displays numerous small, white punctate markings.
other_distinctive_markers: The lateral flank and fin exhibit a high-frequency distribution of white speckling or depigmentation spots across the dark grey epidermis.
